subject: general
question: What is the full form of AIDS?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (AIDS)** is a chronic, potentially life-threatening condition caused by the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).
 
• By damaging your immune system, HIV interferes with your body's ability to fight infection and disease.
 
• AIDS is the final stage of HIV infection, and not everyone who has HIV will develop AIDS.
 
• There is currently no cure for HIV/AIDS, but it can be managed with proper medical care, particularly antiretroviral therapy (ART).
 
• With early diagnosis and proper medical care, people with HIV can live long, healthy lives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **HIV** is primarily spread through unprotected sex, sharing needles, and from mother to child during childbirth or breastfeeding.
 
• Prevention methods include practicing safe sex, using clean needles, and taking pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) if at high risk.
 
• Regular testing and early diagnosis are critical to managing and preventing the spread of HIV.
 
• Global efforts continue to focus on education, prevention, and treatment to combat the spread of HIV/AIDS.
